fields.name: CollectionMapAttributeBase mapping metadata
fields.description: The structured-parameter name a derived collection-mapping attribute declares for a model's collection property; supplied at construction and read-only thereafter.

members.name: ParameterName
members.description: The name supplied at construction by the derived attribute; exposed read-only thereafter via the public ParameterName property and does not change once set.

representations.CSharp: public string ParameterName { get; }, assigned once by the protected constructor CollectionMapAttributeBase(string parameterName).
